environment_constraints: Backend API: https://hotel-os-api-52qe.onrender.com (via NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL env var). DO NOT delete app/bookings/mock.ts or app/hotels/mock.ts — other pages still import them. Working tree is clean at commit f314404 on branch master.
contribution_requirements: No 'any' types anywhere. All new files must be TypeScript-strict. Do not introduce new npm dependencies. Keep the existing 'use client' / server component boundary patterns.
key_patterns: API client is apiClient in app/lib/api/client.ts (get/post/patch/delete, attaches Bearer token from localStorage, handles 401 refresh). Auth state via useAuth() from app/lib/auth-context.tsx — exposes { user: AuthUser | null, isLoading: boolean, setUser, signOut }. Auth gate pattern: useEffect(() => { if (!isLoading && !user) router.push('/auth/signin?redirect=<path>'); }, [isLoading, user, router]). Design tokens: --tp-bg, --tp-surface, --tp-primary, --tp-secondary, --tp-accent, --tp-accent-light, --tp-border, --tp-muted, --tp-gold. calcNights/calcBookingCost from app/lib/booking.ts. Booking status UI tabs: upcoming | completed | cancelled (lowercase, type BookingStatus in app/bookings/mock.ts). API statuses from NestJS: HELD, CONFIRMED, CHECKED_IN, CHECKED_OUT, CANCELLED, PAYMENT_PENDING, NO_SHOW, PENDING.
directory_structure: app/lib/api/ — API client modules (client.ts, auth.ts, search.ts); app/lib/ — shared utilities (booking.ts, auth-context.tsx); app/checkout/ — checkout page; app/bookings/ — my-bookings page; app/booking/confirmation/ — post-payment confirmation page; app/components/ — TravelerNav, Footer; .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts
